name: Project approval
summary: The validity review of a submitted project: approve, return for corrections, reject and resubmit. Also covers the enterprise order-form and signing path, and what a customer may do while waiting.

roles.note: Track3D implementation or customer success review normal projects (PROJ-REQ-007). Enterprise admins approve through the order-form path (PROJ-REQ-012). No approval permission string exists in the seed catalog.

actions.note: Who approves which projects is DEC-024

nfr.statement: Time from submission to an approval decision.
nfr.open_question: Is there a review turnaround commitment (for example one business day), and who is alerted when it's missed?

requirements.title: New projects wait for Track3D's validity review
requirements.statement: A normal newly created project waits for a manual validity review, and approval, by Track3D implementation or customer success. User accounts never wait for approval (USER-REQ-002).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer submits a new project with no auto-approval rule
acceptance_criteria.then: It waits for approval, and the review appears in Track3D's queue

requirements.title: While pending, customers can only view project details
requirements.statement: Project setup means onboarding users with permissions, adding 2D and 3D designs, and configuring the project and progress. While a customer-submitted project is pending approval, the customer can only view its details.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.when: The customer opens it and tries to invite a user or add a design
acceptance_criteria.then: They can view the project details, but both actions are refused

requirements.title: Approve, return for corrections, or reject, and rejected projects can be resubmitted
requirements.statement: A review can approve the project, return it to Draft for corrections and resubmission, or reject it. Rejection isn't final: the customer can correct a rejected project and resubmit it. The stored transitions, and whether Draft and revision-requested are the same, are open (DEC-018).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

open_checks: Map approve, return, reject and resubmit, plus immediate first-project setup, onto status, construction phase, live flag and auto-approval exceptions

acceptance_criteria.when: The reviewer returns it for corrections with a note
acceptance_criteria.then: The customer sees the note, can edit the project and can resubmit it

acceptance_criteria.when: The customer corrects it and resubmits
acceptance_criteria.then: The resubmission is accepted for review

requirements.title: Status updates record revision notes and start approval work
requirements.statement: Updating a project's status saves it with the date. A revision request also saves the reviewer's note and adds it to the note history. Approval also schedules the project's jobs and team work, including automatic archiving (PROJ-REQ-016). This update does not check which status changes are allowed.

acceptance_criteria.when: A reviewer sets it to NeedRevision with the note "Wrong address"
acceptance_criteria.then: The status is NeedRevision, and "Wrong address" is the current note and is in the note history

requirements.title: Enterprise approval through an order form and e-signature
requirements.statement: In the enterprise path, submitting a project for approval generates an order form. The signing authority is emailed a DocuSign link, and signing the form sets the project to Approved.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: An enterprise project submitted for approval
The super-admin enters the signing authority's email
acceptance_criteria.when: The project is ready for signing
acceptance_criteria.then: The signing authority is emailed a DocuSign link

acceptance_criteria.given: The signing authority signs the order form

requirements.title: Enterprise admins approve or reject from a details view
requirements.statement: Company super-admins and regional admins can approve or reject projects, after seeing the project's details.

acceptance_criteria.when: A super-admin or regional admin opens the approval screen
acceptance_criteria.then: They see the project's details and can approve or reject it

requirements.title: People are told when a project is approved or rejected
requirements.statement: When a project is approved or rejected, its users are notified by email and push notification.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project is approved or rejected
acceptance_criteria.then: Its users get an email and a push notification
